topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't shake the image of their face when they told me they don't remember. It’s like the world I knew, the one where we were inseparable, just... vanished. I keep thinking about all the times we spent together, the secrets we shared, the laughter. I wonder if I should have said something differently, if maybe I could have jogged their memory somehow. Maybe I should have reminded them of our favorite games or the treehouse that was our fortress. But now, it feels like I’m holding on to a story that’s only mine, a past that maybe wasn’t as important as I thought it was. I just hope they know, even if they don’t remember, that they were once the world to me.
